name: Hanoi La Siesta Premium Hang Be
area: Hanoi Old Quarter (27-29 Hang Be St)
notes: Splurge pick. Source quoted US$90-130/night (midpoint converted at 25,963 VND/USD, rounded). 300m from Hoan Kiem Lake, quiet inner courtyard, own spa. PRICE IS A 2026 GUIDE TYPICAL, NOT A QUOTE FOR 24-25 DEC - Christmas nights sell out and price up; book within 2-4 weeks. Hanoi round 1 is ONE night (24-25 Dec), not two: the 25th is spent on the 21:00 sleeper bus - see data/decisions.json (dec-loop-start).

name: Hanoi Emerald Waters Hotel & Spa
area: Hanoi Old Quarter (38 Lo Su St)
notes: Source quoted US$65-150/night (midpoint converted, rounded). Rooftop pool with Old Quarter views, family suites. Good for a couple wanting a pool. Hanoi round 1 is one night (24-25 Dec), not two - see data/decisions.json (dec-loop-start).

name: Peridot Grand Hotel & Spa
area: Hanoi Old Quarter
notes: Best mid-range value pick. Source quoted US$75-110/night. Modern 2022 interior, rooftop bar. Recommended FIRST among the mid-range trio. Hanoi round 1 is one night (24-25 Dec), not two - see data/decisions.json (dec-loop-start).

name: O'Gallery Premier Hotel & Spa
area: Hanoi Old Quarter (5 min walk to Hoan Kiem)
notes: Source quoted US$80-120/night. Boutique format, free fruit bar. Hanoi round 1 is one night (24-25 Dec), not two - see data/decisions.json (dec-loop-start).

name: Hanoi Tirant Hotel
area: Hanoi Old Quarter
notes: Source quoted US$50-90/night. Rooftop bar, central. Good value if the Peridot is full. Hanoi round 1 is one night (24-25 Dec), not two - see data/decisions.json (dec-loop-start).

name: Hanoi Pearl Hotel
area: Hanoi Old Quarter
notes: Source quoted US$60-100/night. Skyline rooftop bar, central. Solid and unexciting. Hanoi round 1 is one night (24-25 Dec), not two - see data/decisions.json (dec-loop-start).

name: Essence Hanoi Hotel & Spa
area: Hanoi Old Quarter
notes: Source quoted US$60-110/night. Central, free breakfast. Hanoi round 1 is one night (24-25 Dec), not two - see data/decisions.json (dec-loop-start).

name: La Siesta Classic Ma May
area: Hanoi Old Quarter (Ma May St)
notes: Source quoted US$70-130/night. Family-friendly sister property of La Siesta Premium; same group, often slightly cheaper. Hanoi round 1 is one night (24-25 Dec), not two - see data/decisions.json (dec-loop-start).

name: Hanoi La Siesta Premium Hang Be (NYE night)
area: Hanoi Old Quarter (27-29 Hang Be St)
notes: The NYE night (31 Dec) - the scarcest and most expensive single night of the window. Book this FIRST. Alternative if sold out: spend NYE in Tam Coc (quiet and much cheaper) and return to Hanoi on 1 Jan for the flight.

name: Tam Coc Garden Resort
area: Ninh Binh - Tam Coc
notes: BEST all-round mid-range pick. Source quoted US$35-55/night. Bungalows in a genuine garden with an unobstructed view of the Mua Cave karst range, pool, 15 min walk to the pier. Best bet for the photographer.

name: Ninh Binh Hidden Charm Hotel
area: Ninh Binh - Tam Coc / Trang An
notes: Source quoted US$50-80/night. Rooftop pool, 12 min walk to the pier. Comfort-seekers.

name: Tam Coc Rice Fields Resort
area: Ninh Binh - Tam Coc
notes: Splurge option for Ninh Binh. Source quoted US$55-90/night. Boutique, garden setting, 20 min walk to the pier.

name: Trang An Retreat Homestay
area: Ninh Binh - Trang An
notes: Source quoted 450,000-650,000 VND/night. Five rooms in a garden between karst formations built with local stone and wood; 1.5 km to the Trang An boats, 3 km to Hoa Lu. Good for couples and nature photographers.

name: Tam Coc Sunshine Homestay
area: Ninh Binh - Tam Coc
notes: Value pick. Source quoted 300,000-450,000 VND/night. Family-run, 6 rooms around a courtyard, 400 m from the boat wharf, breakfast included (pho, banh cuon, eggs). Bicycle rental 50,000 VND/day.

name: Yen Bien Luxury Hotel
area: Ha Giang city (517 Nguyen Trai St)
notes: Post-loop reset night in Ha Giang city. 4-star, from 1,065,000 VND/night per one source and US$25 per another (figures disagree - verify). Rooftop pool, mountain views, 5-min walk to the Km 0 milestone, 5 min from the bus station area.

name: The Bluestone Lodge
area: Ha Giang city (239 Nguyen Van Linh St)
notes: From 550,000 VND/night. Small boutique with a rustic feel and very friendly staff.

name: Truong Xuan Resort
area: Ha Giang city (Quang Trung)
notes: Source quoted US$19/night. Eco setting, closest resort to town.

name: H'Mong Village Resort
area: Ha Giang - Quan Ba (about 15 min from Heaven's Gate)
notes: Loop night 1 option. Source quoted traditional double US$14, deluxe triple US$23. H'Mong-style bungalow resort with mountain views and an infinity pool. NOTE: on a bookable tour the operator assigns loop accommodation - you do not usually get to choose it. Confirm before paying.

name: Ancient Town Guesthouse
area: Ha Giang - Dong Van old town (29 Pho Co St)
notes: Loop night 2 option, in the middle of Dong Van old town - the best-located stay for the loop's midpoint. From 450,000 VND/night. Budget-friendly with character.

name: Lo Lo Eco Lodge
area: Ha Giang - Lo Lo Chai, Dong Van
notes: Closest stay to the Lung Cu flag tower. Source quoted dorm from US$8, earthen family room ~US$17, wooden bungalow with balcony ~US$25. Village homestay - confirm whether a private room is available.

name: Auberge de Meo Vac
area: Ha Giang - Chung Pua, Meo Vac
notes: Source quoted ~US$14. Century-old H'Mong earthen house - the most characterful stay on the eastern end of the loop. Loop routing may or may not include a Meo Vac night; ask the operator.

name: Dao Lodge Nam Dam
area: Ha Giang - Nam Dam village, Quan Ba
notes: Source quoted ~US$13/night. Asia green-architecture award; Dao ethnic village setting 20 min past Quan Ba. Natural loop night 1.

name: P'apiu Resort
area: Ha Giang - P'apiu Hill, Bac Me (40 min from Ha Giang town)
notes: SPLURGE, listed for completeness - ~US$550/night all-inclusive (converted at 25,963 VND/USD). 5-star, maximum 12 guests, whole-resort privacy in the mountains. Almost certainly out of the S$1,500/person budget. Not recommended; included so the option is visible.
